title: Prescription History Report
description: A prescription history (patient profile) report as a clinician, pharmacist or underwriter reads it: the summary risk indicators, the patient, and each dispensed prescription with its prescriber and pharmacy.

risk_indicators.description: The summary indicator boxes at the top of the report.

mme_average.description: Morphine milligram equivalent (MME) assessment value, e.g. 66.04.

mme_period.description: The period the MME figure covers, as printed, e.g. '30-day average'.

multiple_provider_prescribers.description: Number of prescribers ('Dr') in the multiple provider episodes box.

multiple_provider_pharmacies.description: Number of pharmacies ('Rx') in the multiple provider episodes box.

multiple_provider_period.description: Look-back period of the multiple provider episodes box, as printed, e.g. 'Last 6 months'.

overlapping_period.description: Look-back period of the overlapping prescriptions box, as printed.

risk_score_max.description: Maximum possible risk score, from 'Max Score=N'.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth exactly as printed (do not reformat).

address.description: Patient address as printed on one line.

prescriptions.description: Every dispensed prescription row, in the order printed.

prescriber_name.description: Prescriber name and credential, e.g. 'Welby, Marcus MD'.

prescriber_dea_number.description: Prescriber's DEA registration number, the third line of the Prescriber cell.

dispenser_dea_number.description: Pharmacy's DEA registration number, the third line of the Dispenser cell.

date_issued.description: Date the prescription was written, exactly as printed.

date_filled.description: Date the prescription was filled, exactly as printed.

date_sold.description: Date the prescription was sold to the patient, exactly as printed.
